HOST        https://dossier.example

ENDPOINTS
  GET   /api/v1/schema                              (no token)
  GET   /api/v1/fields                              fields:read
  POST  /api/v1/shares                              shares:mint

SCOPES              fields:read fields:write documents:write shares:mint shares:read
FIELD CATEGORIES    identity travel tax health contact
FIELD STATUSES      empty active pending withdrawn
SHARE STATES        live expiring expired revoked

LIMITS
  pagination.fields.default_limit  50
  pagination.fields.max_limit      200
  uploads.max_file_bytes           26214400

EXPIRY
  REQUIRED    yes
  PRESETS     PT24H P7D P30D P90D

  Presets are ISO 8601 durations, not timestamps. Compute expires_at yourself: now + preset (e.g. now + "PT24H" = 24 hours from now), and send that timestamp.

  No expiry — This is the exception: the link works until you revoke it by hand.
